WITH returns_in_period AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT sr.sr_ticket_number,
           sr.sr_item_sk,
           sr.sr_customer_sk,
           sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    FROM store_returns AS sr
    JOIN date_dim AS d2
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = 2001
      AND d2.d_moy = 8
),
store_bucket_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (r.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_leq_30,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (r.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 30) AND (r.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_31_60,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (r.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 60) AND (r.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_61_90,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (r.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 90) AND (r.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_91_120,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (r.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_gt_120
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN returns_in_period AS r
      ON ss.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number
     AND ss.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_customer_sk = r.sr_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d1
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk
)
SELECT st.s_store_name,
       st.s_company_id,
       st.s_street_number,
       st.s_street_name,
       st.s_street_type,
       st.s_suite_number,
       st.s_city,
       st.s_county,
       st.s_state,
       st.s_zip,
       CAST(SUM(sbt.days_leq_30) AS bigint) AS "30 days",
       CAST(SUM(sbt.days_31_60) AS bigint) AS "31-60 days",
       CAST(SUM(sbt.days_61_90) AS bigint) AS "61-90 days",
       CAST(SUM(sbt.days_91_120) AS bigint) AS "91-120 days",
       CAST(SUM(sbt.days_gt_120) AS bigint) AS ">120 days"
FROM store AS st
JOIN store_bucket_totals AS sbt
  ON st.s_store_sk = sbt.ss_store_sk
GROUP BY st.s_store_name,
         st.s_company_id,
         st.s_street_number,
         st.s_street_name,
         st.s_street_type,
         st.s_suite_number,
         st.s_city,
         st.s_county,
         st.s_state,
         st.s_zip
ORDER BY st.s_store_name,
         st.s_company_id,
         st.s_street_number,
         st.s_street_name,
         st.s_street_type,
         st.s_suite_number,
         st.s_city,
         st.s_county,
         st.s_state,
         st.s_zip
LIMIT 100
